body:

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
Hello, this player will be punished appropiately, thank you for the report, I apreciate it :), have a nice day!

Edit: I would like to add that they were supposed to recieve a 7 day tempban (which I punished for) as it was his second offense. Racism should be at least a tempban for first offense, rather than a verbal warn. I will see what I can do to change that.

-Junr
